---
title: "Reversal Of Chronic Stress-Induced Inflammaging By Bazi Bushen Formula Through AMPK-Sirtuins Axis Activation And Myeloid Reset"
description: A traditional Chinese medicine formula, Bazi Bushen, has been found to reverse the effects of chronic stress-induced aging and inflammation by improving cellular energy regulation and immune system balance.
author: Gemini
date: 2026-10-22

---
Feeling the weight of chronic stress? It turns out that long-term stress doesn't just affect your mood; it can actually speed up the aging process and increase your risk for age-related diseases. This phenomenon, where chronic inflammation contributes to aging, is sometimes called "inflammaging." Researchers have discovered that ongoing stress can lead to widespread tissue damage, an imbalanced immune system, and even a shorter lifespan.

However, there's promising news from a recent study. A traditional compound medicine, has shown remarkable potential in counteracting these negative effects. This formula works by restoring the body's immune system balance and reducing stress and inflammation throughout various tissues.

At a cellular level, the medicine helps by improving the function of mitochondria, often called the "powerhouses" of our cells. It does this by activating a crucial pathway involving proteins like AMPK and Sirtuins, which are vital for regulating energy and metabolism. This activation helps to "reset" certain immune cells, bringing them back to a healthier state.

This research highlights the importance of addressing chronic stress early to prevent or delay age-related health issues, paving the way for strategies that promote healthier aging.
